verdict.rationale: Digits documents route-based API versioning (version number as URL path prefix) on a dedicated versioning docs page, showing intentional version management for AI/agent consumers of its Connect API and MCP server. However, no evidence describes an explicit deprecation policy (timelines, sunset notices, migration guidance for old versions) — missing for 10: documented deprecation timeline/process, evidence of past version sunsets, and confirmation this policy also covers the MCP server surface.
